# Baja Baby Unscented Shampoo & Body Wash

## Gentle Enough for Newborns and Sensitive Skin

Looking for a fragrance-free baby shampoo that cleanses without harsh chemicals? Baja Baby Unscented Shampoo & Body Wash is an all-natural bath time essential for babies, toddlers, and kids with delicate skin. Its mild formula cleanses hair and skin while hydrating and nourishing them.

## Certified Organic, Plant-Based Care

Made with certified organic, 100% plant-based ingredients, this gluten-free and vegan formula contains no sulfates, parabens, or phthalates. It is EWG Verified, PETA Approved, and pH-balanced for skin that needs extra care. Vitamins and fatty acids help leave hair soft and manageable.

## Glacial Water Base

Each formula starts with glacial water, a pure source known to soothe irritation on sensitive skin. Live enzymes help keep the product fresh without synthetic chemicals.

## Easy to Use, Lasts Longer

A little goes a long way. Just a small amount lathers into a rich, gentle wash for hair and body, so one 12-ounce bottle can serve the whole family.

## Shop Baja Baby Today

Give your little one a bath time routine that is gentle, natural, and worry-free. Add Baja Baby Unscented Shampoo & Body Wash to your cart today.
